title: HAM-VLN: Harnessing Hierarchical Agentic Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
selection_reason: HAM-VLN bounds retained waypoint history and retrieves older memory selectively, requiring no additional LLM calls and reporting over 65% shorter context; this is a concrete reduction in prompt-token and inference-context cost.
